chunks.arabic_text: وَعَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ قَالَ

translations.en: And from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: فِيمَا نَاجَى اللَّهُ بِهِ عَبْدَهُ مُوسَىٰ بْنَ عِمْرَانَ أَنْ قَالَ: إِنِّي لِي عَبْدًا أَبِيحُهُمْ جَنَّتِي وَأَحْكُمُهُمْ فِيهَا، قَالَ مُوسَىٰ: يَا رَبِّ مَنْ هَؤُلَاءِ الَّذِينَ تُبِيحُهُمْ جَنَّتَكَ وَتَحْكُمُهُمْ فِيهَا؟ قَالَ: مَنْ أَدْخَلَ عَلَىٰ مُؤْمِنٍ سُرُورًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: إِنَّ مُؤْمِنًا كَانَ فِي مَمْلَكَةِ جَبَّارٍ وَكَانَ مُولَعًا بِهِ، فَهَرَبَ مِنْهُ إِلَىٰ دَارِ الشِّرْكِ، وَنَزَلَ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ، فَأَلْطَفَهُ وَأَرْفَقَهُ وَأَضَافَهُ، فَلَمَّا حَضَرَهُ الْمَوْتُ، أَوْحَىٰ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ إِلَيْهِ: وَعِزَّتِي وَجَلَالِي لَوْ كَانَ فِي جَنَّتِي مَسْكَنٌ لِمُشْرِكٍ لَأَسْكَنْتُكَ فِيهَا، وَلَكِنَّهَا مُحَرَّمَةٌ عَلَىٰ مَنْ مَاتَ مُشْرِكًا، وَلَكِنْ يَا نَارُ ارْبَعِيهِ وَلَا تُؤْذِهِ، قَالَ: وَيُؤْتَىٰ بِرِزْقِهِ طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ، قُلْتُ: مِنْ الْجَنَّةِ؟ قَالَ: أَوْ مِنْ حَيْثُ شَاءَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ

translations.en: In what Allah confided to His servant Musa ibn 'Imran, saying: 'I have servants whom I permit to enter My Paradise and rule therein.' Musa said: 'O Lord, who are these whom You permit to enter Your Paradise and rule therein?' He said: 'One who brings joy to a believer.' Then Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'A believer was under the rule of a tyrant, and the tyrant was fond of him. He fled from him to a land of polytheism and stayed with a man from the polytheists, who befriended him, showed him kindness, and hosted him. When death approached him, Allah revealed to him: 'By My Might and My Glory, if there were a dwelling in My Paradise for a polytheist, I would have made you dwell therein, but Paradise is forbidden to one who dies as a polytheist. So, O Fire, spare him and do not torment him.' I asked: 'Will he be given his sustenance twice a day?' He replied: 'Or from wherever Allah pleases.'

en.summary: This hadith narrates that Allah revealed to Prophet Musa (Moses) that those who bring joy to a believer are granted entry to Paradise and authority within it. It illustrates this with a story of a believer who fled a tyrant and was hosted by a polytheist; upon his death, the polytheist was granted a special exception to remain in Paradise despite dying as a polytheist, because of his kindness to the believer, and his sustenance would be provided from wherever Allah willed.
en.seo_question: Who are the servants permitted to rule in Paradise according to Allah's revelation to Musa?

key_terms.مَنْ أَدْخَلَ عَلَىٰ مُؤْمِنٍ سُرُورًا: One who brings joy to a believer
key_terms.طَرَفَيِ النَّهَارِ: Twice a day (ends of the day)
